scope: Compact metadata discovery reference. No forecast values, fitted model or performance results.

full_catalogue.usage: Search by cycle, exact tag or family; inspect the selected source rows and questionnaire rather than loading the complete catalogue into a prompt.

mask_dictionary.one: At least one source row with the exact key in that cycle.
mask_dictionary.zero: No source row with that exact key; not a zero forecast, zero respondents or proof of suppression.
mask_dictionary.position: Left-to-right positions match cycle_order. No date/year stripping or wildcard merging.
mask_dictionary.comparison_limit: Presence alone does not prove matched units, horizon, wording, buckets or respondent panels.

family_definition.method: Exact source tuple; no regex stripping of years, no semantic merging, no imputation. Stable broad descriptive family does not prove stable wording, horizon, bucket, units or respondent composition. Exact question tags and value-field metadata remain separately retained.
family_definition.id: First 16 hex characters of SHA256 over canonical UTF-8 JSON of exact tuple, prefixed family-. Collision checked.

qualitative_content_fixture.check: Existing PDF text inspected alongside complete workbook question-number set; no qualitative responses inferred from absent XLSX rows.
qualitative_content_fixture.interpretation: This XLSX supplies numeric/date aggregate elements, not all qualitative questionnaire content. PDF is complementary. This check is limited to September 2026.

date_semantics: survey_release_date is questionnaire distribution date, not public result/XLSX publication. survey_due_date is response deadline. Date-encoded U strings are retained as source-cell pointers; day precision or aggregation mapping is not invented.
panel_semantics: SPD/SMP predecessor panel codes and Dealer/Participant post-January-2025 codes are retained verbatim; conceptual correspondence does not establish a stable firm panel. Combined is publisher-provided, not recomputed.
category_count_rule: Exact count is separate from count_1 through count_5 rating-category frequencies. A valid zero category frequency must not become missing or a zero respondent denominator.
unit_rule: No automatic numeric normalization. The stable21-column schema and General formatting are not a common unit contract.
counting_rule: 63,190 rows are aggregate statistic/element records, not distinct firms, independent forecasts or scored predictions.
limitations: Capture and HTTP modification times do not authenticate original historical bytes or first public availability.
Only 26 data links present in the captured official page are in scope; no guessed links or unlinked/earlier files were sought.
Question text is stored only by exact UTF-8 hash and source J-cell pointer. The source workbook is required to read wording and verify units.
Descriptive families can span targets and horizons; exact value-field metadata and question text must gate any later comparison.
No blanket unit conversion, forecast construction, errors, returns, trading signal, respondent microdata or performance model.
Missing tuple/tag/panel rows remain absent; no explicit suppression policy is inferred.
The 24 newly captured workbook families were not individually reconciled to their full question/results PDFs; prior two-workbook fixtures remain the bounded PDF-checked route.

September 2026 native Q1a/Q1c qualitative commentary is in results PDF pages 4/5 but has no corresponding XLSX rows. Do not infer qualitative answers from absent tags; this specific reconciliation was not extended to every cycle.
